scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build:server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint:server
scripts.test: npm run test -w client && npm run test:server
scripts.clean: rm -rf client/dist client/node_modules/.vite && cd server && ./gradlew clean
